يحتفين (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِينَ (yaḥtafīna) /jaħ.ta.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# يُحْتَفَيْنَ (yuḥtafayna) /juħ.ta.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
